title: Introduction to Bayesian statistics with R
subtitle: A gentle introduction to Bayesian statistics with R for people not familiar with any of these.
summary: A gentle introduction to Bayesian statistics with R for people not familiar with any of these.
content: You are a student or a researcher interested in Bayesian statistics and R? But all the tutorials and courses that you have found are too intimidating?
With the easystats team, we have created a very gentle and introductory course for beginners.
👉 Get Started with Bayesian Statistics using R 👈
